_comment: The ONLY place where the existing store's table and column names appear. Run `npm run inspect-schema` against the real database and adjust. Defaults match the VKC store (Prisma, PostgreSQL).
_timestampStorageHelp: utc_timestamp = TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE holding UTC (Prisma default). timestamptz = TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE.

users.onlyWhere: u."role"::text = 'CUSTOMER' AND u."isActive" = TRUE AND u."isBlocked" = FALSE

storeAdmins.where: u."role"::text = 'ADMIN' AND u."isActive" = TRUE AND u."isBlocked" = FALSE
